offering_description.value: Provides broadband, voice and video services to rural households and businesses, along with wholesale network access for other carriers. Its subsidiaries deliver these services over fiber, copper, coaxial cable and fixed wireless networks.

quotes.quote: LICT Corporation is a holding company with subsidiaries providing integrated broadband, voice and video services to business and residential customers in rural markets across the United States. The company, with operations in Utah, New Mexico, Kansas, Wisconsin, Iowa, California and Oregon, provides services through its existing and expanding network infrastructure, including thousands of miles of fiber, copper, coaxial cable, wireless towers and owned wireless spectrum. The company also provides fixed wireless services through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sound Broadband.
